source.title: Emotion expression in body action and posture.

confidence_rationale: Empirical production study (source_quality 0.70; n=10 actors, posed portrayals) using the Body Action and Posture (BAP) coding system to show that emotion-specific information is carried by patterns of body MOVEMENT and posture, and -- decisively for MECH-360 -- that many of these patterns are interpretable as reflecting functional components of emotion, specifically modes of APPRAISAL and ACTION READINESS. This is the L2 'expression-as-action-geometry' anchor: expression is the geometric residue of action-readiness, not a separate signal. mapping_fidelity 0.78. Discounted by posed-vs-spontaneous portrayal and small actor sample (transfer_risk 0.42). exp_conf unchanged 0 -- PROMOTES NOTHING.
failure_signatures: Portrayals are ACTED by professional actors, not spontaneous emergent behaviour -- posed expression may overstate the lawfulness of the action-geometry/emotion mapping relative to naturally-emergent behaviour.

Most emotions were expressed by MULTIPLE body-movement patterns (many-to-one), so the geometry->affect read-out is not a clean bijection; an observer inferring state from geometry (the V5 consumer) faces real ambiguity.
Human full-body emotional display -> REE agent action-geometry is a substantial morphological transfer; REE has no body, so 'posture' maps only metaphorically onto trajectory shape.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Body movement and posture convey emotion-specific (not merely intensity) information; using the BAP coding system, specific patterns of body action systematically distinguish portrayed emotions, and most patterns are best explained as reflecting functional components of emotion -- modes of appraisal and action readiness -- rather than as arbitrary expressive codes.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-360 asserts expression is the emergent geometric RESIDUE of affective arbitration -- the visible style (approach, retreat, hesitation) falls out of which trajectory the affect vector selected. Dael et al is the empirical case that human emotional expression IS organised as action-geometry tied to action-readiness/appraisal, exactly the 'expression-as-action-geometry' (Dael/Mortillaro/Scherer 2012 body-action coding) anchor the AE-9 gate names. Expression as configured action, not a bolt-on output channel.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Portrayals are posed by actors, not spontaneous/emergent; expression is many-to-one (most emotions -> multiple body patterns), so the geometry->state read-out is ambiguous; and the human full-body morphology transfers only metaphorically to a bodiless REE agent's trajectory geometry. Grounds the PRINCIPLE (expression = action-readiness geometry), not a specific REE read-out mapping.
mapping.source_context: Human emotion-portrayal production study, 10 professional actors, 12 emotions, BAP coding; behavioural/affective science.

confidence_components.notes: High conceptual mapping_fidelity (action-readiness IS the MECH-360 frame) but real transfer risk from posed human full-body display to bodiless agent geometry, plus small posed sample. Net 0.60.
